result.description: A fictional tabletop ultrasonic humidifier designed for quiet office corners and bedside use. The EchoNest 14L features a 1.4-liter tank, three mist levels, an automatic shutoff sensor, and soft ambient lighting in a matte ceramic-style shell. Intended for dry indoor environments rather than data storage or gaming accessories.
result.title: Lunara EchoNest 14L Compact Desktop Humidifier
